scope: fold-3/fold-4 cross-fit of weight-space-anchored full released-U-Net adaptation with source-disjoint exact-L1C auxiliary supervision

architecture.student: exact released U-Net initialization with all convolutional layers trainable and all BatchNorm affine/running state frozen
architecture.scene_evidence: top 1% observable student-minus-teacher dense-logit change, bounded to plus/minus two logits
architecture.scene_routing: learned score evidence modifies Sentinel-2 only; Landsat current spatial-Prithvi scores remain exact identities
architecture.dense_interpolation: released teacher logit plus fixed strength times student-minus-teacher logit
architecture.positioning: weight-space L2-SP adaptation of the released representation; distinct from prior frozen-teacher side adapters

smoke.scope: two real mixed-source optimization batches and exact identity check; no held-fold outcome scoring

sampling.mars_rule: equal label x sensor request mass, then equal physical-site mass within stratum
sampling.external_rule: equal physical-site mass within each fixed single-label source
sampling.resulting_label_mass: 0.5 positive and 0.5 negative; no external development rows

training.numeric_precision: CUDA BF16 autocast with explicit finite-gradient assertion
training.endpoint_rule: fixed epoch 3 for both cross-fit directions; no held-fold epoch selection
training.augmentation: joint quarter-turn and reflection transforms with wind-vector rotation

search.scene_formula: sigmoid(logit(current spatial-Prithvi score) + strength * bounded top-1%-correction evidence) on Sentinel-2; exact identity on Landsat
search.mask_formula: released logit + strength * (fine-tuned student logit - released logit)
search.selection_rule: all gates, then worst-fold AP, worst-fold recall, worst-sensor AP, paired-site AP lower bound, paired-site IoU lower bound, pooled AP, smallest strength

gates.pass_action: freeze a new-seed source-disjoint confirmation; do not open external development, fold 2, or official test

invariants: Draft status permits only identity and finite-optimization smoke tests; outcome scoring requires frozen hashes.
Each endpoint fits only the opposite MARS development fold plus fixed source-disjoint auxiliary manifests.
UNEP and CloudSEN12 development manifests, fold 2, folds 0/1, and official-test inputs are not loaded.
The full-model trainability, frozen BN contract, anchor, endpoint, strengths, loss, routing, seeds, and gates are fixed before held-fold scoring.
The student starts at exact released weights and failure writes no model artifact.
Bulk data, model artifacts, and prediction caches remain Git-ignored.
